## Value creation at Ferd

At Ferd, we work to create value for companies and individuals, both independently and in collaboration with others.

![](https://ferd.no/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/Saltdalshytta-2-MG-404x540.jpg)[_Partnerships_](http://ferd.no/en/frontpage/partnerskap-med-ferd/)

As a family-owned investment company, we look for partners who share our values. When we take a significant ownership stake in a company, we seek to make an active contribution as a value-adding partner. Our flexibility means that we can adapt to each individual company in order to ensure that the partnership benefits all parties to the greatest possible extent.

![](https://ferd.no/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Marienlyst-041-404x540.jpg)[_Marienlyst_](https://ferd.no/en/frontpage/marienlyst/)

In 2020 Ferd became the proud owner of what is one of the sites of greatest significance to be developed in Oslo in recent times, namely Marienlyst. In order to succeed in creating a sustainable, creative and vibrant district, Ferd will make teamwork and dialogue its primary tools.

![](https://ferd.no/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Electro-Lab_DSC2009-404x540.jpg)[_International growth_](http://ferd.no/en/frontpage/internasjonal-vekst/)

As an active and long-term owner of the companies in which we invest, we seek to influence how they develop, and we encourage and challenge them to think big. We also contribute expertise, networking and capital, working together to realise their international potential.
